issues.display_title: Issue #1680: Bug: Fields Other Than Name are Editable When Editing a Coupon
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

When editing an existing coupon (promo code), fields other than the coupon name can still be edited. In edit mode, only the coupon name should be editable; all other fields should be read-only.

Expected behavior

  • All other fields (product & discount, duration & limits, expiry, etc.) are read-only and cannot be changed.

Dev edit form evidence:

Promocode Form Component Optimization Design

Goal

Streamline promocode-form.component.ts (1255 lines) by separating the complex UI (User Selector) into a standalone component and extracting the data manipulation logic (payload builder, currency formatting, validators) into a Service.

Architecture

Parent Component:

  • PromocodeFormComponent: Focuses on managing the main FormGroup, reacting to UI changes, and handling main API integrations.

New Child Component:

  • PromoUserSelectorComponent: Manages the search, selection, and visibility toggle features for the specific user list (Allowed Users).

New Service:

  • PromocodeFormHelperService: Contains a collection of data extraction functions:
    • Building payloads from form values (_createAddPromoCodePayload, _createEditPromoCodePayload, etc.).
    • Managing dynamic custom validators.
    • Formatting currency inputs and cleaning numeric values.

Data Flow

  • On initialization, the component fetches the validators from PromocodeFormHelperService.
  • When the user interacts with the user list, PromoUserSelectorComponent fully operates the checkbox and filter states, supplying the final email array to the parent component via an Output/Event.
  • When the user clicks Save, the component sends the raw form.value data to the helper service to be compiled into a clean payload. Then, the component executes the API via PromocodesService.

Verification

  1. Discount inputs (Percentage/Amount types) & currency formatting limitations work smoothly.
  2. The Create and Edit promo code processes successfully send a payload that is 100% precise according to the old format.
  3. The search/select features on the Allowed Users list render cleanly and reactively.
